designNotesHeading: Why it is built this way
designNote1Body: Kinetic type stretching from condensed to wide on load, NOW in bone and NOT YET in brass, pushed to opposite edges. The tension in the framework is the first thing a visitor feels.
designNote2Body: The imagery system is light through a doorway, grain, and duotone abstraction. It never looks like a church website template, and it holds up until a real photo library exists.
designNote3Body: The Watch rail is 9:16 with burned in captions, because most of that audience watches with sound off and the platform rewards a 30 to 60 second clip that teaches something specific.
designNote4Body: The diagram carries König’s argument, not just a timeline. The third band is Christ, and it is the reason the picture says something the other two bands cannot.
